description.en: Former Nabataean kingdom plus adjacent Decapolis cities; capital Bostra in the Hauran.
description.ar: المملكة النبطية السابقة إضافة إلى مدن الديكابوليس المجاورة؛ العاصمة بصرى في حوران.
description.he: הממלכה הנבטית לשעבר בתוספת ערי הדקאפוליס הסמוכות; הבירה בוצרה בחורן.

sources.quote: It appears that Philadelphia, Gerasa, and probably Dion went to Arabia
About this time, Palma, the governor of Syria, subdued the part of Arabia around Petra and made it subject to the Romans.
This region also has, in addition to some towns, great cities, Bostra, Gerasa and Philadelphia, all strongly defended by mighty walls.
No territorial changes occurred between Palestine and Arabia after the transfer of southern Transjordan, the Negev and most of the Sinai Peninsula from Arabia to Palaestina under the Tetrarchy.

description.en: Reduced to northern Transjordan and the Hauran after the transfer of the south to Palaestina.
description.ar: تقلصت إلى شمال شرق الأردن وحوران بعد نقل الجنوب إلى فلسطين.
description.he: הצטמצמה לצפון עבר הירדן ולחורן לאחר העברת הדרום לפלשתינה.

sources.quote: the transfer of southern Transjordan, the Negev and most of the Sinai Peninsula from Arabia to Palaestina under the Tetrarchy
Constantine added the southern half of Arabia to the province

notes.en: Date of transfer: Tetrarchy (284–305) per Di Segni vs Constantine (306–337) per Britannica. Moab's assignment uncertain.
notes.ar: تاريخ النقل: الرباعية (284–305) بحسب دي سيغني مقابل قسطنطين (306–337) بحسب بريتانيكا. وإسناد موآب غير مؤكد.
notes.he: תאריך ההעברה: הטטרכיה (284–305) לפי די סגני לעומת קונסטנטינוס (306–337) לפי בריטניקה. שיוך מואב אינו ודאי.
